responses.text: What's up with the tower in Vegas being all lit up? I didn't know it could do that.
Even that old House bastard gave in to the NCR. We're the only ones to make a stand!
What are we going to do now that Papa's dead?
I hope Papa knew what he was doing when he left you in charge.
A robot dog? Never seen one of those before.
Your pal's one ugly motherfucker.
{Shocked, a little afraid}Holy hell, is that a Nightkin?
{Slightly sarcastic}Nice robot.
You know you're traveling with a fucking murderer?
Haven't seen a Follower around here in years.
Huh?
What?
I ought to bleed you.
Fuck off and die.
Like we don't have enough problems.
Just get the fuck out of here.
What the fuck are you doing showing your face here?
Why are you even here?
Crazy-ass mother fucker.
You been dosing on too many of Jack's chems?
You're almost as crazy as some Fiends I know.
{Sarcastic}Oh great, just who I wanted to see.
You going to fuck shit up again?
{Cautious}What do you want this time?
You should have been with us in our glory days. You'd have loved it.
Share a whiskey with me sometime?
I wish there were more like you.
I like you, stranger. You've stood by us when not many would.
Good to see you again.
Why'd you come here?
Come to gawk at the Great Khans, have you? Fuck off.
What do you want?
The Legion and the NCR have mobilized their forces at Hoover Dam - it'll be time soon.
It's starting to feel like tensions are coming to a boil. There will be full-scale war soon.
Seems like everybody with a stake in the Mojave is gearing up for something big.
So you've been sucked into the decadence of the Strip as well, have you?
Caesar's veterans are making short work of the NCR - or that's what I hear.
Soon Caesar will send in his best troops from the Arizona campaign - the NCR won't know what hit them.
Those black-armored devils might be new to the Mojave, but they're butchers like all the rest.
The runners are saying that the NCR is sending in their elite shock troops to try and push back the Legion.
NCR spreads its infection to another town, I hear.
I'm glad our brothers have returned home from Boulder City.
Why did you kill our brothers in Boulder City?
More Khan brothers cut down by NCR in Boulder City. We should kill a hundred of them in response!
The 1st Recon butchers are in the field again. I'd love to head down to Forlorn hope and show them we haven't forgotten.
So the NCR makes peace with the Kings now? Where was that mercy at Bitter Springs?
Another tribe was wiped out in NCR territory? Can't say I'm surprised. I hope the surviving Kings learn from this.
Our tribe's final stand will be remembered for a thousand years!
We'll return, stronger than before!
I can't believe they're all gone.
So the Legion hit the murderers at Bitter Springs? Good.
We're not moving as many chems now that the Fiends have been taken out.
Diane's going nuts trying to find a new contact in the Fiends now that Motor Runner's dead.
Typical - even within their highest ranks, the NCR is corrupt.
So, the big bad chief ranger couldn't take the pressure, huh? Good.
If I knew who killed Kimball, I'd buy him a drink.
If you're going to assassinate the president of the NCR, you could at least do it right.
Why the hell would you stop someone from killing Kimball?
If you ask me, a true warrior wouldn't let himself be captured at all - but busting that Legionnaire out of McCarran was an impressive stunt.
I would have thought the monorail bombing would slow the NCR down more.
Whoever blew up that monorail is a damn hero.
Karl's been in a shitty mood since that big explosion at the Fort.
Word's spreading that Caesar is dead. No one seems to know much about how, though.
Caesar can rot in hell for all I care.
Not many get the favor of Caesar - even Papa hasn't been to the Fort.
Rumor from the Strip is that House is dead. I hope the old bastard choked on his own tongue.
Mr. House isn't a man to be trusted. Watch yourself.
I heard from one of Melissa's runners that that check-coated bastard got thrown out on his ass.
Papa says "cut off the head and the snake will die." I guess the Chairmen's days are numbered.
I remember the Chairmen from their tribal days. They were punks then, they're punks now.
Yeah?
